sentences.text: The petitioners face prosecution under Sections 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
A crime was registered against the petitioners as Crime No.161 of 2022 of Alathur Police Station, Palakkad, alleging commission of offences under the aforesaid provisions of law.

The matter is now pending as C.C.No.417 of 2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-I,
Alathur.

entities.text:
Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-I,
Alathur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that the entire disputes between the petitioners and the defacto complainant (second respondent) have been settled, as is evident from Annexure-2 affidavit executed by the second respondent/defacto complainant.

It is submitted that no useful purpose would be served in continuing with the prosecution against the petitioners in the light of the settlement of all issues between the petitioners and the second respondent/defacto complainant.

3. The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, would submit that the disputes between the petitioners and the second respondent have been settled and the second respondent does not wish to continue with the prosecution against the petitioners.

4. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor and having regard to the contents of Annexure-2 affidavit executed by the second respondent/defacto complainant and also having regard to the statement of the learned Public Prosecutor that the issues between the petitioners and the second respondent have been settled, I am of the view that this is a fit case where, a jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. can be invoked to quash the proceedings against the petitioners.

Accordingly, this Crl.M.C. is allowed and all further proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.No.417 of 2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-I, Alathur will stand quashed.
